meet_name: Andy Valley League Meet, Mt. Ararat High School, Topsham, ME
notes: Image-only scan of a Hy-Tek Meet Manager printout (5 pages), read from the page images. Date: every page header reads 'ANDY VALLEY LEAGUE MEET # 1 - 4/26/2007', which contradicts the print stamp 5/14/2008 on every page, the 2008 folder and the file name (5_14_08); the header looks copied from last year's meet template, so the date is taken from the file name (2008-05-14) and the meet name is written without the stale '# 1 - 4/26/2007'. Schools: BJH, MAMS, DUR expanded from the team-score page (Brunswick Junior High School, Mt. Ararat Middle School, Durham Middle School); relay team names are truncated in print ('Brunswick Junior Hig', 'Mt. Ararat Middle Sch', 'Durham Middle Schoc') and written as the full names. Grades: the Yr column prints '8t'/'7t'/'6t' throughout (a stray 't' after the digit); written as the digit only; blank Yr (all MAMS and DUR athletes, and John Ryder of BJH) left as ''. Relays: relay letters (A-G) are not kept; the B/C/D/E/F/G teams are separate rows of the same school. Relay marks printed with a leading 'x' (exhibition, non-scoring: e.g. Girls 4x100 BJH G x1:01.52, Durham B x1:12.09; Boys 4x100 BJH D/E/C and MAMS B; Boys 4x400 MAMS B x5:06.76) are written without the x and keep their printed place. Relay runners' grade suffixes ('Anna Cowan 6t') dropped from the names. No runners printed for Girls 4x100 Durham A/B, Boys 4x100 Durham A, Girls 4x400 BJH A and Durham A (athletes []); Boys 4x400 BJH A and Boys 4x100 MAMS B list only 3 runners, as printed. Field marks: Hy-Tek '.00' dropped (26-08.00 -> 26-08; 24-02.50 -> 24-02.5; 15-01.75 kept). A leading 'J' on some high jump / pole vault marks (J4-00.00 Lindsay Eck, J4-06.00 Baxter Worthing, J6-00.00 Boyko/Schwab/Dubs) is a Hy-Tek tie/jump-off flag; the J is dropped, the mark kept. 'FAIL' in high jump / pole vault (no height cleared) kept as printed with place null; 'FOUL' in shot/discus and 'DQ' (Girls 400 Frannie Driscoll) likewise place null. LEFT OUT: Girls 200 Meter Dash places 13-20 (Taylor Hunter 8 BJH, Lindsay Eck 6 BJH, Anna Dimick DUR, Lily Sanders 6 BJH, Pann Nwe 7 BJH, Ashlyn Black 6 BJH, Jessica Boutin DUR, Morgan Jacobs 6 BJH) are printed with marks '17:59:28.5' ... '17:59:32.5' (time-of-day clock readings, not 200 m times); unreadable as marks, so omitted. Names as printed, including lower case and odd spellings: 'mckenzy gary', 'jacob kenney', 'celia ouellette', 'Nathan MACKENZIE', 'Julia MACDONALD', 'Ben ST Laurent', 'Sally Dewktt', 'Kyle Milborurn', 'Hayden Nordtuedt', 'Robert Ganzales', 'Brandy William'. Boys 1600 winner printed 'Andy Reifman-Packet' (name cut by the column width; the 4x400 lists 'Andy Reifman-Packett'), left as printed. Two different athletes 'Elena Deforest' (8) and 'Irina DeForest' (7) as printed. Team scores from the 'Team Rankings - Through Event 32' page.
